title: 第13章 遇见行凶第14章 自寻死路
slug: 有熟练度面板的我学什么都快
content_zh:
新年的第一天，林潜正在房间里清点钱财，算上这个月的双倍月例，总计差不多有十四两银子。
林潜吃过午饭后，直奔炼药堂。
在药堂里面转了好几圈，一咬牙，像是下定了决心。
林潜不再犹豫，准备去买练筋阶段的药，有钱就要花，提升自己实力才是最有保障的，一步慢步步慢。
接着林潜朝着药堂药房而去，
药房柜台里坐着一位老人，正眯着眼睛休息。
“师兄，打扰了，我想买易筋阶段的丹药。”
林潜轻轻的敲了下柜台台面，低声说道。
“你想买哪种丹药？适合易筋阶段的丹药有两种。”
吴老头睁开眼睛，笑呵呵的道，一点也没有因为被林潜打扰休息而面露不满。
吴老头活了大半辈子，为人处世，人情世故比谁都懂。
不然也不会从一个杂役弟子坐到现在这个位置。
要不是他没有武学天赋，说不定现在至少也是个管事。
“吴师兄，我也不知道买哪种，麻烦吴师兄给我讲解一下有哪些适合易筋的药吗？”
林潜虚心请教道。
“适合易筋阶段服用的药有两种，一个是固体汤，一副药材要三百铜板，效果一般；另一个是健筋散，一份要五百铜板，效果的话，肯定是比前面的好。”
吴老头说完摸了摸自己的长须，等待着林潜做出选择。
最终林潜买了七份健筋散，并拿出证明自己药堂学徒的令牌，九折买下，也花了三两多银子。
“果然是穷文富武啊”
回家路上，林潜拿着强筋散，有些肉疼道。

一个月月例三两银子，够一家三口生活两三个月，但是对一名武者来说，就有点相形见绌了，还不够买药。
不再多想，林潜快速回到房间。
他先继续刷了两个小时医书，然后服了一份健筋散，不一会林潜感到身体发热，像是有使不完的劲，林潜足足修炼了四五个小时才感到疲倦。
擦了擦额头上的汗渍，林潜调出熟练度面板发现通臂拳熟练度直接增加了1%，抵得上他两三天的修炼了。
“一份健筋散增加1%，还不错，就是太费钱了。”
林潜感叹道。
.......
苍云山脉东侧。
即使还是冬季，山林中也有部分树木绿意盎然，林中远处偶尔传来鸟鸣声。
阳光透过树叶，将树枝上的霜融化了，最后在枯叶覆盖的地上形成大大小小的不规则的黄斑。
噗嗤！
一只大脚踩进小水洼，略带浑浊的泥水顿时四处飞溅。
林潜身着极为朴素，背着背篓，手拿开山刀劈砍挡路枝条，朝着没有足迹的地方行走，眼睛时不时打量四周环境及脚下植被，像是在寻找什么。
content_en:
On the first day of the new year, Lin Qian was counting his money in his room. Counting this month's double, the total amount was almost fourteen taels.
After Lin Qian had lunch, he went straight to the medicine refining hall.
After walking around the medicine hall several times, he gritted his teeth and seemed to have made up his mind.
Lin Qian no longer hesitated and was going to buy medicine for the muscle training stage. If you have money, you have to spend it. Improving your own strength is the most guaranteed thing, one step at a time, one step at a time.
Then Lin Qian headed towards the Yaotang Pharmacy,
There was an old man sitting at the pharmacy counter, resting with his eyes squinted.
"Senior brother, excuse me, I want to buy the elixir for the Yijin stage."
Lin Qian gently knocked on the counter and whispered.
"Which elixir do you want to buy? There are two elixirs suitable for the muscle-changing stage."
Old man Wu opened his eyes and said with a smile, not showing dissatisfaction at all because Lin Qian interrupted his rest.
Old man Wu has lived for most of his life and knows how to deal with the world and the ways of the world better than anyone else.
Otherwise, I would not have gone from being a handyman disciple to my current position.
If he hadn't had any martial arts talent, he might at least be a steward now.
"Senior Brother Wu, I don't know which one to buy. Could you please explain to me what medicines are suitable for tendon-relaxing medicine?"
Lin Qian humbly asked for advice.
"There are two types of medicine suitable for the tendon-reducing stage. One is a solid soup, which costs 300 copper coins per serving. The effect is average; the other is Jinjin Powder, which costs 500 copper coins per serving. In terms of effect, it is definitely better than the previous one."
After speaking, Old Man Wu touched his long beard and waited for Lin Qian to make a choice.
In the end, Lin Qian bought seven copies of Jianjin Powder and took out the token proving that he was an apprentice in the medicine hall. He bought it at a 10% discount and spent more than three taels of silver.
"As expected, he is poor in literature and rich in martial arts."
On the way home, Lin Qian took the Qiangjin Powder and felt some pain in his flesh.
Thirty taels of silver a month is enough for a family of three to live for two or three months, but for a warrior, it is a bit dwarfed and not enough to buy medicine.
Without thinking any more, Lin Qian quickly returned to the room.
He continued to read medical books for two hours, and then took a dose of Jianjin Powder. After a while, Lin Qian felt his body heat up, as if he had endless exertion. Lin Qian practiced for four or five hours before feeling tired.
Wiping the sweat on his forehead, Lin Qian brought up the proficiency panel and found that his proficiency in the Tongjiquan had increased by 1%, which was equivalent to his two or three days of practice.
"A serving of Jianjin Powder increases by 1%, which is not bad, but it is too expensive."
Lin Qian sighed.
.......
The east side of Cangyun Mountains.
Even though it is still winter, some trees in the mountain forest are full of green, and the sound of birdsong can occasionally be heard in the distance in the forest.
The sun shines through the leaves, melting the frost on the branches, and finally forms large and small irregular yellow spots on the ground covered with dead leaves.
Poof!
A big foot stepped into a small puddle, and the slightly turbid muddy water suddenly splashed everywhere.
Lin Qian was dressed in extremely simple clothes, carrying a basket on his back and holding a machete in his hand to chop down the branches blocking the road. He walked toward a place where there were no footprints. His eyes looked at the surrounding environment and the vegetation under his feet from time to time, as if he was looking for something.
